name: Stacked glowing lines
what: Five bold, tilted, glowing lines pop in one after another on a dark ground, each landing with a small bounce where it stays, until the last and largest line closes the stack under the others.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1, f21, f41, f61 and f81 one line each pops in where it stays: it grows from a dot in 4 f, overshoots 6 %, dips 4 % and settles by 15 f later; line 5 (the largest) bounces about twice as hard; the glow haze builds up; then everything holds to f120

tracks.name: line 5 pops in
tracks.what: bottom, flat and the largest, bouncing harder
tracks.easing: grow in 4 f, 14 % overshoot, 12 % dip, settle
